class.name: IfcBuildingElementProxyType
class.brief_description: Definition from IAI : Theÿ IfcBuildingElementProxyType defines a list of commonly shared property set definitions of a building element proxy and an optional set of product representations. It is used to define an element specification (i.e. the specific product information, that is common to all occurrences of that product type). NOTEÿ The product representations are defined as representation map

members.member: Predefined types to define the particular type of an building element proxy. There may be property set definitions available for each predefined or user defined type.
